_about: Machine-readable source of truth for 10X Affiliation content. check.mjs and the AI brief read this file. Change the rules here, not in the scripts.

brand.name: 10X Affiliation
brand.audience: Forex IB’s and affiliates who refer traders to brokers and want more from the flow they already have.
brand.promise: A better deal on the same flow: higher rebates, a product that keeps clients trading, and a partner who builds the funnel with you.

shape: 45-degree chamfered corners, taken from the cut in the 10X mark. No rounded cards.

claims.text: +40% average rebate increase per lot for our partners. Same clients, same accounts.
Your offer within 1 hour of the strategy call.
No fees. The broker pays us, not you.
We only earn when your flow does.
Four partner brokers: PU Prime, Premier Markets, STG and MarketsVox.
One partner for deals, products, funnels and a partner manager.

risk_line: Leveraged trading carries a high level of risk. 10X Trader is not available in the US.
individual_results_note: Individual results depend on volume and client activity.

ctas.where: Instagram, one campaign at a time (open question)

hooks.text: You're leaving money on the table. Every single trade.
Your flow is worth more, your deal just doesn't show it.
Most IB’s only negotiate their rate.
We don't just raise your rate.
Not because of skill. Because of structure.
Good IB’s were never the problem. The structure was.
Your referrals are your assets. Let's make them pay.
Retention is the lever most IB’s never touch.
We only earn when your flow does.
Your offer within 1 hour of the call.

pillars.goal: Show that the IB’s current deal underpays their flow
Show that structure, not skill, limits growth
Explain the product that keeps clients trading longer
Reframe churn as lost income the IB can win back
Remove the fear that switching is slow

weekly_mix.rule: Never the same pillar or layout family on two feed posts in a row.

writing_rules: Write IB’s (curly apostrophe, lowercase s), never IBS or IBs.
Lead with the money, then the mechanism.
One number per frame. Worked examples are labelled Example.
No em or en dashes. Ranges take a hyphen: 2-3x.
Headline 10 words or fewer, split dark|muted. Body 30 words or fewer.
No emoji or hashtags inside the design. One emoji at most in a caption.
Second person: you and your flow. We is 10X Affiliation.
One *bold* phrase per body, on the number or the outcome.
Any 10X Trader mechanics carry the risk line.

formats.name: post
formats.note: Default for feed and carousels. The grid crops 34px each side.

manifesto.use: Giant type only: covers and turning points

ruler.use: One big number on a measured scale

phone.use: Notifications landing on a phone (speed, service)
